claims: Milly Alcock is an Australian actress.
Milly Alcock was born on April 11, 2000.
Milly Alcock played Young Rhaenyra Targaryen in the first season of HBO's House of the Dragon (2022).
Milly Alcock's portrayal of the Targaryen princess in House of the Dragon earned her a Critics' Choice Television Award nomination.
Milly Alcock played the younger version of Princess Rhaenyra Targaryen.
Emma D'Arcy portrayed the adult character of Princess Rhaenyra Targaryen.
Milly Alcock was cast while working as a dishwasher in Australia.
Milly Alcock had to keep her role a secret.
Milly Alcock briefly returned for a special guest appearance in House of the Dragon season 2.
Milly Alcock had a role in the Australian series Upright before House of the Dragon.
Milly Alcock was cast as Kara Zor-El / Supergirl in the DC Universe.
